description: Use only when the traveler has told you, in this conversation, how SlickTrip is doing for them (a number from 1 to 5) or what they like or would change, and is happy for it to go to SlickTrip's team. Send their number as rating and their own words as they said them; never invent, soften or add to their opinion, and never send anything else from the conversation. SlickTrip keeps them with their account to improve the service. Needs a signed-in account.

comment.description: Anything else they want the team to know, in their own words.

likes.description: What the traveler likes about SlickTrip, in their own words.

rating.description: How SlickTrip is doing for them, 1 (not great) to 5 (love it), only when they gave a number.

would_change.description: What the traveler would change or add, in their own words.

name: share_feedback

code.description: On an error: a machine-readable kind, e.g. unknown_place

message.description: That the words reached SlickTrip's team, or the error

note.description: What to tell the traveler next

places_assumed.description: Place names this call resolved on its own, e.g. 'Portland = Portland, OR (PDX)'; tell the traveler

suggestions.description: On unknown_place: places to offer the traveler, each with code, name, kind (airport, all airports in the city, nearby airport), city, country

title: Send feedback to SlickTrip
